tasks.title: Rough outline of a straight line
tasks.real_testing:
PASSED
- B1: built a small probe program (specs/sketch-paint-engine/real-testing/T1/probe.cpp) linked to the built libhpq.a. It calls RoughGeometryEngine::outline through the GeometryEngine interface on the line (0,0)->(100,0) with roughness 1, stroke_count 2, max_offset 5 and seed 42, then renders the strokes over the max_offset band to b1_seed42.png -> exactly 2 strokes. The first points are 4.17 and 4.64 from (0,0) and the last points are 2.71 and 3.41 from (100,0). The largest distance from the segment is 3.46, both at the path elements and on the flattened curve. The PNG shows 2 smooth, slightly bowed hand-drawn lines that cross near the ends and stay inside the pink 5 px band. A second run with max_offset 15 and seed 7 also kept every point within 15 (max 14.87).
- B3: same line and options with seeds 1 and 2, drawn in blue and red in b3_seeds1_2.png -> the first strokes differ ("DIFFERENT"), and the PNG shows two clearly different pairs of wobbly lines, all inside the band. Running seed 1 again gives the same strokes.
- B4: roughness 0 with seed 42 (b4_roughness0.png) -> 2 strokes, each from (0.000,0.000) to (100.000,0.000), with a largest distance of 0.000 from the segment. The PNG shows one straight line exactly on the original, with the 2 strokes on top of each other. Extra checks with stroke_count 5, a zero-length line and an empty path did not crash: 5 strokes inside the band, then 2 empty paths for each of the other two. Exit code 0 and no Qt warnings. The project build and ctest also pass, 3/3.
Evidence: specs/sketch-paint-engine/real-testing/T1/

tasks.title: Rough outline of closed and open shapes
tasks.note:
FAILED
- other: rendered RoughGeometryEngine::outline strokes of the ellipse, rounded rect, closed cubic path and open cubic to PNG, both with max_offset 5 (seeds 1, 42, 12345; for example png/ellipse_s1.png, png/roundedrect_s1.png, png/closedcubic_s1.png, png/opencubic_s1.png) and with the default RoughOptions at 2x zoom (png/defaults_curves_x2.png) -> every curved part is drawn as a jagged zigzag. Each curve point is shifted on its own, so the line kinks sharply every few pixels. The rounded-rect corners show small hooks and loops where the stroke folds back on itself, and the open cubic has a small loop near its peak. The ellipse and the circle look scribbled, not like a wobbly hand-drawn curve. The straight sides of the rectangle, triangle and star look correct: smooth bowed lines. -> the spec's goal is "a hand-drawn look, close to Rough.js", where a curve is a smooth wobble around the shape with no spikes or self-loops. The numeric checks of B5 and B7 all hold (probe-output.txt): 2 strokes each, closed strokes start and end at the same point (distance 0), each bounding box is inside the shape's box enlarged by 5, and open strokes start and end within 5 of (0,0) and (100,0) with 93 to 104 between their ends.
Evidence: .worktrees/sketch-paint-engine/T2/specs/sketch-paint-engine/real-testing/T2/

The shapes are rectangle (10,10,100,50), ellipse (0,0,80,40), triangle, rounded rect (0,0,100,60,12,12), a closed two-cubic path and an extra 5-point star.
